# 07 — Command reference

*Derived from `Makefile`.*

44 targets. The compose file is not at the repository root, so a bare `docker compose up` finds nothing: the targets are the interface.

## Targets

| Target | Needs | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `help` | — | — |
| `download-data` | — | Download Costa Rica OSM data from Geofabrik |
| `process-osrm` | — | Extract, partition, and customize OSRM data (PROFILE=$(PROFILE)) |
| `compose-doctor` | — | Show active Docker host and daemon architecture |
| `compose-up` | — | Auto-build OSRM data image, then start Redis + OSRM + API with safe sequencing |
| `compose-down` | — | Stop and remove running compose services |
| `compose-logs` | — | Tail API, OSRM, and Redis logs |
| `compose-health` | — | Quick runtime checks for API and OSRM services |
| `compose-spike-up` | — | Run the spike beside the Docker api service |
| `compose-spike-down` | — | Run the spike beside the Docker api service |
| `compose-spike-logs` | — | Run the spike beside the Docker api service |
| `compose-spike-health` | — | Run the spike beside the Docker api service |
| `jail-spike-up` | jail-stage | Build and run it in the jail (needs jail-bootstrap) |
| `jail-spike-down` | jail-stage | Build and run it in the jail (needs jail-bootstrap) |
| `jail-spike-logs` | jail-stage | Build and run it in the jail (needs jail-bootstrap) |
| `jail-spike-health` | — | Build and run it in the jail (needs jail-bootstrap) |
| `spike-bench` | — | Same loadtest scenario against both gateways (LOADTEST_URL, SPIKE_URL) |
| `parity` | — | Diff both gateways' responses over a seeded corpus |
| `parity-record` | — | Engine proxy that records upstream responses to fixtures |
| `parity-replay` | — | Serve recorded fixtures instead of a real engine |
| `parity-selfcheck` | — | Validate the harness itself; offline, no engine needed |
| `clean` | — | Remove downloaded and processed data |
| `examples` | — | Interactive menu of the example client scripts (examples/) |
| `examples-check` | — | Run every example and check it still works |
| `examples-slice` | — | Rebuild the committed corpus slice from the full dataset |
| `test` | — | Run the pytest suite |
| `corpus` | — | The P0 scenario corpus at all three sizes (CAT-VRP-003 13.1) |
| `lint` | — | Run ruff checks |
| `tier1` | — | docs/tier1, regenerated from the code, the manifests and the binary |
| `catalogue` | — | Rebuild the VRP scenario catalogue from vrp-catalogue-v2.1.src.md |
| `loadtest` | — | Load-test a running gateway (LOADTEST_URL/SCENARIO/RATE/DURATION) |
| `capacity` | — | Full capacity assessment with an OOM guard (LOADTEST_URL, CAPACITY_ARGS) |
| `jail-stage` | — | Upload sources, deploy/freebsd and deploy/env to the host (implied by every jail-* target) |
| `jail-doctor` | jail-stage | Show jail identity, arch, memory and escalation method |
| `jail-host` | jail-stage | Apply host-level prerequisites (kernel tunables, jail.conf loopback, jail resolver) |
| `jail-bootstrap` | jail-stage | Install packages and create the service user in the jail |
| `jail-data` | jail-stage | Build OSRM data in the jail (PROFILE=$(PROFILE)) |
| `jail-up` | jail-stage | Deploy the gateway and (re)start all three services |
| `jail-down` | jail-stage | Stop gateway, OSRM and Redis in the jail |
| `jail-health` | jail-stage | Quick runtime checks for API and OSRM in the jail |
| `jail-logs` | jail-stage | Tail the gateway log and system messages |
| `jail-publish` | jail-stage | Redirect the host's port $(JAIL_API_PORT) to the jail's gateway (edits the host's pf.conf) |
| `jail-unpublish` | jail-stage | Remove that redirect from the host's pf.conf |
| `property-soak` | — | L2 gate: 10^5 generated instances against INV-1..INV-9 (SDD 11.1) |

| Variable | Default |
|---|---|
| `PROFILE` | `car` |
| `COMPOSE_FILE` | `deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml` |
| `COMPOSE` | `docker compose -f $(COMPOSE_FILE) -p osrm-microservice` |
| `PARITY_REFERENCE` | `$(LOADTEST_URL)` |
| `PARITY_CANDIDATE` | `$(SPIKE_URL)` |
| `PARITY_SEED` | `20260822` |
| `PARITY_CASES` | `10` |
| `PARITY_ARGS` | *(empty)* |

| `PARITY_ENGINE_PORT` | `5599` |
| `FENCELINE_BASELINE` | `.fenceline-baseline.json` |
| `LOADTEST_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:8000` |
| `LOADTEST_SCENARIO` | `route` |
| `LOADTEST_RATE` | `25` |
| `LOADTEST_DURATION` | `30` |
| `LOADTEST_ARGS` | *(empty)* |
| `SPIKE_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:$(JAIL_SPIKE_PORT)` |
| `CAPACITY_ARGS` | *(empty)* |

| `HOST_STAGE` | `/tmp/osrm-api-gateway-stage` |
